comment: Goal ID

fields.name: stamp
comment: Time when the goal was accepted
An action goal can be in one of these states after it is accepted by an action
server.
For more information, see http://design.ros2.org/articles/actions.html

fields.name: goal_info
comment: Goal info (contains ID and timestamp).

fields.name: status
comment: Action goal state-machine status.

constants.name: STATUS_UNKNOWN
comment: Indicates status has not been properly set.

constants.name: STATUS_ACCEPTED
comment: The goal has been accepted and is awaiting execution.

constants.name: STATUS_EXECUTING
comment: The goal is currently being executed by the action server.

constants.name: STATUS_CANCELING
comment: The client has requested that the goal be canceled and the action server has
accepted the cancel request.

constants.name: STATUS_SUCCEEDED
comment: The goal was achieved successfully by the action server.

constants.name: STATUS_CANCELED
comment: The goal was canceled after an external request from an action client.

constants.name: STATUS_ABORTED
comment: The goal was terminated by the action server without an external request.
An array of goal statuses.
Cancel one or more goals with the following policy:
- If the goal ID is zero and timestamp is zero, cancel all goals.
- If the goal ID is zero and timestamp is not zero, cancel all goals accepted
at or before the timestamp.
- If the goal ID is not zero and timestamp is zero, cancel the goal with the
given ID regardless of the time it was accepted.
- If the goal ID is not zero and timestamp is not zero, cancel the goal with
the given ID and all goals accepted at or before the timestamp.

fields.name: goal_info
comment: Goal info describing the goals to cancel, see above.
Return codes.

fields.name: return_code
comment: Return code, see above definitions.

fields.name: goals_canceling
comment: Goals that accepted the cancel request.

constants.name: ERROR_NONE
comment: Indicates the request was accepted without any errors.
One or more goals have transitioned to the CANCELING state. The
goals_canceling list is not empty.

constants.name: ERROR_REJECTED
comment: Indicates the request was rejected.
No goals have transitioned to the CANCELING state. The goals_canceling list is
empty.

constants.name: ERROR_UNKNOWN_GOAL_ID
comment: Indicates the requested goal ID does not exist.
No goals have transitioned to the CANCELING state. The goals_canceling list is
empty.

constants.name: ERROR_GOAL_TERMINATED
comment: Indicates the goal is not cancelable because it is already in a terminal state.
No goals have transitioned to the CANCELING state. The goals_canceling list is
empty.
